//: THREE named lists, all SHRINK ONLY — never add a class to any of them. A class not on its list fails the gate; a listed class the code no longer has fails as stale until it is deleted here. To shrink one, migrate a component to `.vm-btn` (src/styles/button-shared.css) and delete its bespoke class. Enforced by scripts/check-bespoke-buttons.mjs (pnpm lint:bespoke-buttons, in check:all). These were COUNT budgets (37/58/61) until the counts let a swap through: delete one button, write another, and the total held. The lists below are exactly what those counts measured, except that the by-name list is keyed by definition SITE ("<file> <class>"), so `.react-flow__controls-button`, styled in two files, appears twice: a listed name defined in a new file is a new bespoke button, not an old exemption.
//bespokeButtonClasses: By NAME, per definition site "<file> <class>": each src/**/*.css file that defines a class whose name contains btn/button, excluding the canonical .vm-btn / .popup-icon-btn / .universal-toolbar-btn.
//bespokeButtonClasses-correction: 78, not 73, after a MEASUREMENT FIX (audit 20260815-163607 #12): the collector anchored at line start, so only the FIRST class of a selector was seen and 5 real bespoke buttons — `.tiptap-editor .code-copy-btn` among them — were absent from the list entirely. The true pre-migration count was 85, not 80; seven classes were then deleted. Still a decrease against the merge base, so no allowRaise entry is required. Do not read the 73→78 step as a regression.
//styledButtonClasses: By USAGE: classes applied to a <button> in src/**/*.tsx whose CSS re-derives a button surface (padding plus a border or background). Added because the name check was evadable by naming — `.workspace-approval-approve` styled a real button with its own padding, radius and border and was never counted, so the list read 88/88 while the drift the gate exists to catch was happening. 61 of these 80 are invisible to the name check. This is a NEW measurement of a previously unmeasured surface, NOT a longer list.
//shapeDriftClasses: By SHAPE: classes applied to a <button> whose declared padding, border-radius or font-size differs from `.vm-btn`'s, compared AFTER resolving var() so a literal and its token spelling count as equal. The first two lists count controls; this one measures WHICH token each control picked — the drift that survives a fully tokenised codebase, where `.approval-dialog__btn` was 6/14 + radius-md + font-md against the canonical 6/12 + radius-sm + font-sm and both passed every existing gate. A NEW measurement of a previously unmeasured axis, NOT a longer list.
//shapeDriftClasses-scope: 80 is a superset on purpose: it includes icon-only buttons (padding: 0) and pill chips (--radius-pill), which are legitimately not text buttons. Triage moves each entry into one of three outcomes — migrate to `.vm-btn`, promote a genuinely-missing variant onto the primitive, or record `/* button-shape-ok: <reason> */` in the rule body. A bare marker with no reason is rejected. Do not exempt in bulk; an exemption is a claim that the deviation is intended.
